name: Readout-first cross-domain factorization and discriminating assay proposal

statement.latest: For a present assay reader R0 and declared future challenge target P_u(s)=R1(F_u(s)), a deterministic prediction based solely on present readout is admissible only if ker(R0) subseteq ker(P_u); equivalently P_u = g_u o R0 (CAN-165). Where this fails, the native-step biological inference remains HOLD. A separately proposed intervention design selects among feasible u to distinguish candidate hidden states through future readouts.
statement.note_ascii: These are instances of existing factorisation and quotient requirements, NOT a newly discovered universal law or an identified biological observer map.

definitions.R0: typed finite present assay readout, not root state
definitions.P_u: future readout after explicitly declared intervention u
definitions.ker: indistinguishability kernel of a declared reader
definitions.F_u: root CAN-003 or a clearly labeled domain proxy; no hours-per-step conversion
definitions.G: physical assay-specific encoder; not calibrated here
definitions.hidden_kernel: exact discrete hidden-state convolution structure from DRL; not a fitted PBMC memory model
